BiblicalUsage: Chashman is wealthy, a prince, and it appears once: princes shall come out of Egypt, and Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a promise that reaches past Israel: the princes of Egypt will come, and Ethiopia will stretch out her hands to God.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
